title: Azure Model Router: Model ID not surfaced when using azure.chat

linked_prs.title: fix(openai): extract meta data from first chunk that contains any
linked_prs.body:
> [!NOTE]
> I'm not sure how we feel about adding Azure-specific code to the OpenAI Provider implementation.

## Background

- We read the `modelId` and other meta information from the first chunk in the OpenAI provider ([source](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/348fd104aa18adc5e423f9c2bb2c8d50d690e10a/packages/openai/src/chat/openai-chat-language-model.ts#L484-L491))
- The first chunk from the `model-router` response has `"id":"","model":""`
- The first chunk includes `prompt_filter_results` which I think is Azure-specific:

  > The `$response` object contains a property named `prompt_filter_results` that contains annotations about the filter results. If you prefer JSON to a .NET object, pipe the output to ConvertTo-JSON instead of Format-List.

  —https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/concepts/content-filter-annotations?tabs=powershell

## Summary

Instead of reading metadata from only the first chunk, keep trying to find metadata until any was returned. Also treat `0` as falsy for `"created"`.

## Manual Verification

`examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/azure-model-router.ts`
